name: api.breakreach.com
description:
Run your social media from Claude. Create, schedule and publish posts across
  12 platforms (X, Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Bluesky, Reddit, Telegram…), pick best-time
  slots, upload media, and pull unified analytics — without leaving the conversation.
  Authentication: OAuth 2.1 (authorization code + PKCE, dynamic client registration)

_published_faq.name: How do I add api.breakreach.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add api.breakreach.com to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.breakreach.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the api.breakreach.com MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: api.breakreach.com provides these MCP tools: create_post, delete_post, get_analytics, get_next_slot, list_accounts, list_pinterest_boards, list_posts, list_workspaces, and upload_media.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to api.breakreach.com?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to api.breakreach.com in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
api.breakreach.com requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
api.breakreach.com is developed by Breakreach. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
